title: Mummified pharaohs in the Cairo museum with cranial deformation, looking like gray aliens

tellings.quote: national museum in Cairo and you see some of these mummified you know pharaohs they look very short. They clearly they've engaged in some sort of cranial deformation to mimic the gods and they look like gray aliens.

plain: In the national museum in Cairo, Egypt, some of the mummified pharaohs look very short, says Michels. He says their skulls were clearly reshaped on purpose, which he takes as an attempt to look like their gods, and that they end up looking like gray aliens, the big-headed figures of UFO lore. Michels tells this himself as something seen at the museum, without naming a source, in an episode about the pyramids.
